w5Mentions.firstLine: 📼 RERUN ×3 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +75% HP, +36% damage, +1 in the pack.)

You walk in open-handed — and it goes wrong. They don't want peace. You're exposed, off-balance, nowhere to slip to until your next turn. (Walk In failed.)

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
firstContext: 🌙 Raid — Stonebridge came in the night from the northwest. They carried off ~1200 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)
📺 SYSTEM: "📡 The fifth draft stays in the wings — blood your fighters (0 of 2 veterans)."

— DAY 115 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Overnight, Hickory Nuts (in shell) went bad — beyond saving. You leave it for the flies.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Big-Eyes." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (13/8/5), with 5 wave-4 fought, 12 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Raj Patel ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
